exposure: Maternal Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate (TDF) administration in third trimester
outcome: Prevalence of chronic hepatitis B infection in pregnancy
Incidence of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of HBV
HBsAg status in children at 9 months
cohort: The study included 10,866 pregnant women and their pre-existing children, with 395 women having chronic HBV infection who completed the study along with their newborns.
finding: The intervention protocol resulted in all children testing negative for HBsAg at 9 months, demonstrating the feasibility of eliminating MTCT of HBV infection.
